entities.summary: Gilbert Asante is a Ghanaian creative director, photographer, and a multidisciplinary artist. He is best known for his viral images of Ghanaian celebrities including Joselyn Dumas, Boxing legend Azumah Nelson, Lydia Forson, and Big Brother Nigeria Housemate, Nengi.
